from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the collection, identifying itself and its references to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as named in the text")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of OTHER provided papers (from the collection) that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all parsed papers from the collection to allow downstream citation graph construction."""
    papers: list[Paper]
